address: 9 bis avenue de la Gare, Saint-Priest, 69800, France
bio: Le Restaurant is 10 minutes from Lyon Saint-Priest Parc Technologique. Sit at your table surrounded by artwork by young artists and enjoy well-crafted traditional cuisine, with a few exotic twists. The menu is rooted in the terroir: lentils and runny poached egg flavoured with bacon, or artisan-made hot sausage poached in wine and cut into good generous slices!...
